other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via aggregate features on combined data
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates group-wise summary statistics (mean, median, std) and frequency encodings across the combined train and test datasets. This leaks information about the test set distribution into the training features.

other_failure_modes.name: Validation leakage via early stopping
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the validation fold to determine early stopping for LightGBM, and then generates out-of-fold predictions on that exact same validation fold. This makes the out-of-fold predictions artificially optimistic and biases the downstream ensemble weights.

summary: The solution implements a robust cross-validated ensemble with extensive feature engineering, but suffers from severe data leakage because imputation, group statistics, and frequency encodings are computed on the combined train and test data. Additionally, the 'Id' column is erroneously used as a feature and incorrectly formatted in the final submission, and LightGBM's out-of-fold predictions are biased due to early stopping on the validation fold.
